outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E micrograph and spatial gene-expression heatmap plots, not a bar/summary plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of micrographs (H&E and RNAscope images), not a quantitative plot.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing every individual tumor sample value with median and 95% CI overlaid; individual points are already displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart of mean ± SD with individual replicate dots (n=3) overlaid on each bar.
